what_this_is: Computed values read from the REAL Button and PhotoImage rendered against the stylesheet Next emitted from src/app/globals.css. Numbers here are what a browser resolves, not what the source says.

unverified_in_this_environment.hover_and_pressed_paint: Chromium headless-shell does not advertise (pointer:fine) — matchMedia reported pointerFine:false — so the media-gated hover overlay cannot paint here and :active on a synthetic mouse-down did not resolve. The rules are proven present in the shipped CSS (`.fb-cta:not(:disabled):hover:after` inside `@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)`, and `:active:after`); their paint is unverified from this sandbox. The transparent result is the gate working, not the overlay broken.
unverified_in_this_environment.real_typefaces: next/font families are injected by the app layout; the QA page maps --font-inter/--font-fraunces to system fallbacks, so sizes/rhythm are exact and glyph shapes are not.
unverified_in_this_environment.in_app_context: Screens are rendered as an isolated mount, not inside the live app, because the member routes need a signed-in session this sandbox does not hold.
